title: KK Split Crowned Croatian U17 Champions After Final Masterclass
description: ZAGREB - The Croatian U17 National Championship (Prvenstvo Hrvatske za kadete) concluded in dramatic fashion at the Dubrava sports complex in Zagreb, where KK Split put on a dominant display to defeat traditional rivals KK Cibona 88-72 in the grand finale, capturing the prestigious national youth crown. Led by a historic individual performance from tournament MVP Luka Leni UkiÄ‡, Split defied early-season expectations to cap off a remarkable run through the Jedinstvena Kadetska Liga (JKL) and the Final tournament.
imageCaption: KK Split Crowned Croatian U17 Champions After Final Masterclass-May 25, 2026

title: KK Cibona have won U17 National Championship
description: KK Cibona U17 - KK Zadar U17 74-66 KK Cibona have won U17 National Championship. In the Final game they edged KK Zadar U17 74-66. Both teams nailed 18 points each at the start and only due to a 12-11 run, Cibiona had a 1-point halftime advantage. KK Cibona managed to push the tempo for good in the second half and secured 26-22 and 18-15 rallies. Zvonimir Dujakovic (203-F-2008) stepped up with 20 points and Ante Garac (183-G-2009) netted 16. Sime Grbin (C-2008) replied with 19 points in a loss and Jakov Toncinic (2008) poured in 15.
imageCaption: KK Cibona have won U17 National Championship (Photo: hks-cbf.hr)

title: Zadar celebrate U17 National title
description: Zadar U17 - Cibona U17 89-80 Zadar celebrated U17 National title beating Cibona 89-80. Trailing 4 points at the end of the first quarter, Zadar posted a 32-21 surge in the second frame. Moreover, they closed the campaign with a 22-14 rally to seal the win. Luka Bicic (177-PG-2007) was unstoppable with 38 points for the winners, whilst Toni Josipovic (191-G-2007) netted 23. Bruno Bubalo (198-PG-2007) and Borna Katanovic (197-SF-2007) replied with 26 points each in the losing effort.
imageCaption: Zadar celebrate U17 National title (Photo: hks-cbf.hr)

title: Zadar win U17 League 22/23 season!
description: Zadar have won U17 League 22/23 season. They overcame Cibona 90-72 in the Final game. Michael Ruzic (206-F-2006) and Toni Josipovic (194-G-2007) top-scored for the winners with 14 points each, whilst Vito Perkovic (200-F-2006) and Andro Mireta netted 13 apiece. Luka Bicic (2007) followed them with 12 points in a win. Josip Pavkovic (206-C-2006) replied with 23 points in the losing effort.
imageCaption: Zadar win U17 League 22/23 season! (Photo: KK Zadar)

title: Cibona win U17 Championship
description: Cibona have won the U17 Championship in Croatia. In the Final game they edged Zadar 107-103 in overtime. Luka Francesevic (193-G-2005) top-scored for the winners with 35 points and Zvonimir Kujundzic (202-F-2005) delivered 20. Josip Pavkovic (206-C-2006) poured in 16, whilst Karlo Krizanac and Bruno Bubalo had 14 each. Luka Bilokapic (188-SG-2005) answered with 32 points in a loss and Roko Lukic (195-F-2005) scored 31.

title: Bosco celebrate U17 title
description: Bosco celebrated U17 Championship title. They beat Cibona 88-80 in the Final. Luka Krajnovic (192-SG-04, agency: PEPI SPORT) scored game-high 31 points to lead the winners. He was named the MVP after the game. Cibona led by six points at halftime 49-43. But Bosco went on a 45-31 second half run to snatch the win. Mihael Tomic (C-04, agency: PEPI SPORT) provided 17 points for the champions. Marko Vucic (200-F-04) answered with 28 points for Cibona.
